packageRules.description: This fork publishes a rollup bundle that inlines the thirty d3-* modules and their own dependencies, so they are devDependencies here but they ARE the shipped code: a bump changes what consumers execute. Renovate types devDependency bumps chore(deps), which release-please hides and never releases; type these build(deps) instead - a visible, releasing section - so a bump of bundled code always reaches a published version. Other devDependencies (rollup, commitlint) stay chore.
